artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the spatial Newtonian $n$-body problem with $n \geq 3$: point masses $m_1,\dots,m_n>0$ in $\mathbb{R}^3$ interacting by Newtonian gravitation, with Hamiltonian
\[
H(q,p) = \sum_{i=1}^{n} \frac{\|p_i\|^2}{2 m_i} - \sum_{1 \leq i < j \leq n} \frac{m_i m_j}{\|q_i - q_j\|},
\]
defined on the open subset of $T^*(\mathbb{R}^{3n})$ where $q_i \neq q_j$ for $i \neq j$. Reduce by translation invariance: fix the center of mass at the origin and the total linear momentum to zero, obtaining a Hamiltonian system on the corresponding reduced phase space. For each real number $e$, let $\Sigma_e = H^{-1}(e)$ denote the energy surface in this reduced space, and reparametrize the Hamiltonian flow on $\Sigma_e$ by a smooth positive time change so that the resulting vector field $X_{H_e}$ is complete on $\Sigma_e$ (this can be done by dividing $X_H$ by a positive function that grows fast enough near collisions and at infinity). Denote by $\Omega(X_{H_e}) \subset \Sigma_e$ the nonwandering set of the resulting complete flow.

Question: For every energy value $e \in \mathbb{R}$, is $\Omega(X_{H_e})$ nowhere dense in $\Sigma_e$?
artifact.status_search_result: The question, originally posed by M. Herman, appears to remain open. It is repeatedly cited as an open problem in celestial mechanics, including in surveys and works following Féjoz's writeup of Herman's proof of Arnold's planetary KAM theorem; no resolution (in either direction) of the nowhere-dense nonwandering set conjecture for the n-body problem (n ≥ 3) has been reported.

status_evidence.title: Compactification of the Energy Surfaces for n Bodies
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses Herman's question on whether the nonwandering set of the n-body Hamiltonian flow is nowhere dense on energy surfaces, treating it as an open problem motivating compactification studies.
status_evidence.claim: The Herman nowhere-dense nonwandering set question for the n-body problem is referenced as an open problem in recent literature.

status_evidence.title: Four Open Questions for the N-Body Problem
status_evidence.snippet: Recent monograph listing major open questions for the n-body problem.
status_evidence.claim: The n-body problem continues to have several recognized open questions, with no announced resolution of Herman's nonwandering-set question.
